ui.setupHelp:
1. At [developer.intuit.com](https://developer.intuit.com) create an app for the **QuickBooks Online Accounting API**.
2. **Keys & credentials**: copy the Development keys into the sandbox fields below, Production keys into the production fields.
3. On the same page add redirect URI `https://<your conduit host>/api/plugins/quickbooks/callback`.
4. Save the fields, pick the environment, then run **Connect to QuickBooks** and sign into the company. **Connection status** confirms.
